answered.sql: SELECT MD.deviceName, C.name AS company, S.fullname AS scientist FROM MedicalDevices MD JOIN DeviceDevelopment DD ON MD.id = DD.medicalDeviceId JOIN Companies C ON DD.companyId = C.id JOIN Scientists S ON DD.scientistId = S.id

candidates.meaning: Show all the medical devices and their makers.
